summary: Verified the Heat Index Safety Chart is now visible on the Daily Worksheet (/dashboard) page below the weather card WITHOUT hover. Logged in as admin (100001/admin123). Chart renders with data-testid='heat-index-chart', shows title 'Heat Index Safety Chart', current feels-like ('Current: 74°F'), and all four levels: 80-89°F Caution, 90-102°F Extreme Caution, 103-124°F Danger, 125°F+ Extreme Danger. Weather widget displays location (Castroville, Texas), temperature (77°F), feels-like (74°), humidity (85%), wind (NNE 20 mph). No console errors on the worksheet page. Refresh button was not exposed via data-testid, but 'Refresh Sheet' and weather 'Updated Just now' indicators were visible. Since feels-like (74°F) is below 80°F, no level highlight is expected and none is shown — correct behavior.

design_issues.screen: Daily Worksheet / Heat Index Safety Chart
issues: No visible highlight when feels-like (74°F) is below Caution range - acceptable; consider adding a subtle 'Safe / Below thresholds' indicator to reassure users the chart is data-driven.

critical_code_review_comments: Weather refresh button lacks a dedicated data-testid (e.g., 'weather-refresh') to make automated testing robust.
Consider adding data-testids for feels-like, temperature, location, humidity, wind sub-elements inside weather-widget for granular testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Daily Worksheet route resolves at /dashboard (redirects from /daily-worksheet). Heat Index Safety Chart selector: [data-testid='heat-index-chart']. Verified with feels-like temp 74°F (no highlight). To test highlight state, weather source would need to return higher feels_like.
